about: A Ruby library for reading and editing Word documents.

prs.title: Edits to Word for the web files are saved
prs.broken: Documents saved by Word for the web keep their text in a differently named part, so every edit was silently lost on save.
prs.changed: The library now remembers which part it read and writes the changes back to it.
prs.matters: Filled-in templates and edits actually end up in the saved file.
